blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in image restoration have greatly improved global image fidelity, producing visually plausible results across most regions of an image. Nevertheless, even high-quality restorations often exhibit localized failures, including artifacts in semantically important regions such as faces and text, structural inconsistencies, and texture mismatches. Although these errors typically affect only a small portion of the image, they often dominate the overall perceptual quality of the result. In this work, we propose Failure-Aware Image Restoration (FAIR) to address the "last-mile" problem in image restoration. Rather than applying one uniform generative prior over the whole image, we condition a single-pass restoration model on both where local failures are likely to occur and what corrective guidance each region requires. This region-bound conditioning enables fine-grained and controllable restoration that improves semantic accuracy and stylistic consistency in critical regions while maintaining faithful, high-quality restoration elsewhere. Our method complements existing restoration pipelines by shifting the emphasis from global fidelity to local perceptual acceptability. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach resolves common failure cases and improves perceptual quality, bridging the gap between technical accuracy and practical usability.
blocks.zh: 最近图像修复方面的进展大大提高了全球图像的忠实性,在大多数区域产生了明显可行的图像结果。 尽管如此,即使是高质量的修复也经常出现局部性故障,包括面部和文字,结构不一致,纹理不匹配等具有重要意义的区域的文物. 虽然这些错误通常只影响图像的一小部分,但它们往往支配着结果的整体知觉质量. 在这项工作中,我们提出失败-意识到图像恢复(FAIR),以解决图像恢复中的"最后一英里"问题. 我们不对整个图像采用一个统一的基因,而是在局部可能发生故障的地方和每个区域需要何种纠正指导时,以单一通道恢复模式为条件。 这种有区域限制的调制可以进行精细和可控的修复,提高关键区域的语义准确性和语义一致性,同时在其他地方保持忠实、高质量的修复。 我们的方法补充了现有的恢复管道,把重点从全球忠诚转向地方的认知接受。 广泛的实验表明,拟议的方法解决了常见的故障案例,提高了知觉质量,缩小了技术准确性与实用性之间的差距.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in perception-oriented image restoration ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024b ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) have substantially improved overall image quality, producing results that are globally plausible and perceptually rich.
While existing methods have demonstrated impressive performance, we identify an overlooked class of “last-mile” problems in image restoration that fundamentally hinders their real-world deployment.
blocks.zh:
近期在认知导向图像修复方面取得的进展(Lin等人,2024年;Yu等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024年b); Wu 等人,2024a; Chen等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年)大大提高了整体图像质量,产生了全球可信和明显丰富的成果。
虽然现有方法表现出令人印象深刻的性能,但我们发现,在图像恢复方面,有一类被忽视的“最后一英里”问题,从根本上阻碍了其实际世界的部署。

blocks.en:
A near-perfect landscape with a distorted face, or a sharp document with garbled characters, is rarely considered acceptable regardless of how well the remaining regions are recovered.
As shown in Fig. 1 , such localized failures arise consistently under severe degradations, where heavy blur, noise, or compression remove local information beyond recovery, forcing generative priors to hallucinate plausible yet unfaithful content.
Although these errors typically affect only a small portion of the image, they often dominate the perceived quality of the result.
We refer to this challenge as the “last-mile” problem in image restoration: closing the perceptual gap by predicting failure-prone regions from the low-quality input and guiding their restoration with external references.
blocks.zh:
一张脸部扭曲的近乎完美的地貌,或者一张带有被装饰的字符的尖锐文件,无论其余区域恢复得怎样好,都很少被认为是可以接受的.
如图1所示,在严重退化下,这种局部性故障不断出现,严重模糊、噪音或压缩将本地信息除去恢复之外,迫使遗传学前科产生令人信服但却不忠的内容。
虽然这些错误通常只影响图像的一小部分,但它们往往主导了结果的感知质量.
我们把这一挑战称为图像修复中的“最后一英里”问题:通过预测低质量输入的故障易发区域并用外部参考来指导其修复,从而缩小认知差距。

blocks.en:
The last-mile problem stems from a structural limitation of current restoration pipelines.
Resolving it requires two capabilities that existing methods lack: external information to recover content that is irretrievable from the degraded input, and fine-grained local control to apply such information only where it is needed.
Yet existing approaches typically cast restoration as a global reconstruction problem, without explicitly modeling where local failures are likely to occur and, within each at-risk region, what type of failure it is prone to and what corrective guidance it requires.
Consequently, the same generative prior is applied uniformly across the image, from smooth backgrounds to semantically important areas such as faces, text, and logos.
blocks.zh:
最后一英里的问题源于目前恢复管道的结构限制。
解决它需要现有方法所缺乏的两种能力:外部信息,以恢复从退化输入中无法恢复的内容,以及精细的局部控制,只在需要时才应用这种信息。
然而,现有办法通常将恢复工作视为一个全球重建问题,而没有明确的模拟当地可能发生的故障,以及在每个面临风险的区域中,它可能发生的故障类型和需要何种纠正性指导。
因此,从平滑的背景到脸部、文字和标志等具有重要意义的领域,在图像中统一适用同样的先天性。

blocks.en:
The challenge is to introduce external information selectively: it should help regions with insufficient recoverable content without unnecessarily altering regions well constrained by the input.
Even recent semantic-guided methods ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024b ; Sun et al., 2024 ) introduce high-level priors at the image level, while deriving them largely from the corrupted input.
When local information is severely lost, these priors can generate plausible details without ensuring fidelity to the original content.
Restoration therefore needs evidence beyond the input and spatial control to apply it only where needed.
Deferring guidance to post-hoc repair has further costs: it may disturb well-restored regions, while the second model must work from an image already altered by the first, potentially missing original cues or containing new artifacts.
blocks.zh:
挑战在于有选择地介绍外部信息:它应帮助内容不足的地区,而不会不必要地改变受到投入严重制约的地区。
甚至近代的语义指导方法(Yu等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024年b;Sun等人,2024年b)在图像层面引入了高级前科,同时主要来源于腐朽的输入.
当当地信息严重丢失时,这些前科可以产生可信的细节,而不能确保与原始内容保持一致。
因此,恢复工作需要超出投入和空间控制范围的证据,只有在必要时才适用。
推迟对后热修复的引导会增加成本:它可能会扰乱恢复良好的区域,而第二种模式必须从第一种已经改变的、可能缺失的原始提示或包含新文物的图像中发挥作用。

blocks.en:
We propose FAIR , a failure-aware image restoration framework that analyzes the low-quality input, predicts failure-prone regions and their types, and prepares matching conditions before restoration.
Rather than treating the image as a uniform field, FAIR recognizes that under severe degradation, small but perceptually critical regions often require different forms of corrective information.
To study this behavior systematically, we construct a large-scale failure-aware dataset by applying state-of-the-art restoration models to degraded inputs and automatically annotating both where failures occur and what type of failure is present.
Each failure region is additionally paired with an appropriate problem description, yielding region-level supervision aligned with our failure taxonomy.
We observe a consistent pattern in this dataset: restoration failures cluster into a small set of semantically meaningful categories, each requiring different forms and strengths of external guidance.
blocks.zh:
我们提议FAIR, 一个故障意识图像恢复框架, 分析低质量输入, 预测故障易发区域及其类型,
FAIR没有将图像作为一个统一的领域对待,而是承认在严重退化的情况下,小但有概念的关键区域往往需要不同形式的纠正信息。
为了系统地研究这一行为,我们通过应用最先进的恢复模型来退化输入,并自动说明失败发生地点和存在何种类型的失败,来构建一个大规模故障意识数据集.
每个失败区域还有适当的问题描述,产生与我们的失败分类相一致的区域一级监督。
我们在这个数据集中观察到一个一致的规律:恢复失败将组合成一组小类,这些类类都需要不同的形式和优势的外部指导.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , we organize restoration guidance by increasing constraint strength, with more specific guidance addressing progressively harder local failures: (i) semantic instructions and parametric controls for subjective artifacts; (ii) reference exemplars for pattern and texture inconsistencies; (iii) geometric prompts for fine structural correction; and (iv) identity correspondences for identity-critical regions.
Different failures call for different forms of guidance, and FAIR accepts each of them as a condition.
Unlike existing methods that apply uniform generation across the image, FAIR binds each guidance condition to its target region.
Built on FLUX.2-klein-9B ( Labs, 2025 ) with lightweight LoRA modules, FAIR uses region control to specify where additional guidance is provided and a semantic reference to indicate what the restoration should follow.
Training adopts a two-stage curriculum: single-step restoration pretraining, followed by region-anchored fine-tuning with external guidance, spatial control, and region-aware reconstruction reweighting.
Experiments show that FAIR improves perceptual acceptability over strong baselines while preserving quality elsewhere.

实验表明,公平执法提高了对强基线的认知可接受性,同时保留了其他地方的质量。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Image Restoration. Recent progress in image restoration has been largely driven by deep learning, leading to substantial improvements in super-resolution, denoising, and deblurring.
Early CNN-based approaches ( Dong et al., 2015 ; Lim et al., 2017 ; Zhang et al., 2018b ; Dai et al., 2019 ; Mei et al., 2021 ) learn direct mappings from degraded inputs to clean images and achieve strong performance under synthetic degradations.
Transformer-based methods ( Liang et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Zamir et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) further improve reconstruction quality through long-range dependency modeling and more expressive architectures.
GAN-based approaches ( Ledig et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Liang et al., 2022 ) focus on perceptual realism by synthesizing high-frequency details through adversarial training.
Despite these advances, most existing methods remain optimized for global reconstruction objectives such as pixel-level fidelity or perceptual similarity.
As a result, they often fail in localized regions, particularly semantically important areas such as faces and text, where even minor artifacts can substantially degrade perceptual quality.
blocks.zh:
图像恢复。 图像恢复方面最近的进展主要是通过深入的学习推动的,导致超分辨率、消音和破解方面的重大改进。
早期基于CNN的方法 (Dong等人,2015年;Lim等人,2017年;Zhang等人,2018年b;Dai等人,2019年;Mei等人,2021年) 从退化的投入中学习到清洁图像的直接映射,并在合成降解下实现强效.
变形法(梁某1等人,2021年;王某1等人,2022年;扎米尔等人,2022年;陈某1等人,2023年;吴某1等人,2025年),通过远程依附模型化和表现性更强的建筑,进一步提高重建质量.
基于GAN的方法(Ledig等人,2017年;Wang等人,2018年;Wang等人,2021年;Liang等人,2022年)通过对抗训练合成高频细节,注重概念现实主义.
尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数现有方法仍然为全球重建目标优化,如像素级忠诚度或感官相似度。
因此,在局部地区,特别是在面部和文字等具有突出重要性的地区,它们往往失败,即使小的文物也能大大降低知觉质量。

blocks.en:
Diffusion-Based Restoration. Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2020 ; Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) have become a dominant paradigm for image restoration ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Dong et al., 2025 ) , achieving strong perceptual quality across a wide range of tasks.
However, image-level conditioning alone often struggles under severe degradations.
Recent studies report a shift from under-generation to over-generation, where strong generative priors produce hallucinations, structural distortions, and semantic inconsistencies in challenging regions such as faces, fine structures, and textured surfaces ( Yin et al., 2026 ) .
To address these issues, several methods introduce explicit semantic guidance.
PASD ( Yang et al., 2024 ) extracts semantic cues from low-resolution inputs using off-the-shelf vision models and injects them through pixel-aware cross-attention.
SeeSR ( Wu et al., 2024b ) generates degradation-aware tag prompts, while SUPIR ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and CoSeR ( Sun et al., 2024 ) leverage multimodal LLMs to produce richer semantic descriptions.
InstructRestore ( Liu et al., 2025 ) further introduces user-instruction control, and CODSR ( Chen et al., 2026 ) reformulates restoration as one-step generation with region-adaptive priors.
Nevertheless, these approaches remain primarily driven by global objectives and image-level priors, without explicitly predicting where restoration is likely to fail or what guidance each region needs.
blocks.zh:
基于传播的修复。 传播模型(Ho等人,2020年;Song等人,2020年;Dhariwal和Nichol,2021年;Rombach等人,2022年)已成为图像恢复的主要范例(Lin等人,2024年;Yu等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024年a); Chen等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年;Saharia等人,2022年;Dong等人,2025年),在广泛的任务中实现了强烈的认知质量.
然而,光是图像级条件往往就会在严重退化下挣扎。
近期的研究表明,从低代到过代的转变,强烈的遗传学前科在面部,细结构,纹理表面等挑战性区域产生幻觉,结构扭曲,语义不一致(Yin等人,2026年).
为了解决这些问题,几种方法引入了明确的语义指导.

然而,这些方法仍然主要受全球目标和图像层面的先导驱动,没有明确预测恢复可能失败的地点或每个区域需要何种指导。

blocks.en:
Reference-Based Restoration. Reference-based restoration uses external high-quality images to recover details irretrievable from severely degraded inputs.
Early methods rely on patch matching and texture transfer ( Zhang et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2020 ; Lu et al., 2021 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ; Cao et al., 2022 ) , typically assuming curated, strongly aligned references.
Recent diffusion-based approaches relax this requirement: ReFIR ( Guo et al., 2024 ) injects retrieved features through cross-image attention, RASR ( Yan et al., 2026 ) formulates retrieval-augmented reference super-resolution, and AdaRefSR ( Wang et al., 2026 ) adaptively weights reference features according to local relevance.
Nevertheless, these methods use references as a primary condition for overall reconstruction without explicitly modeling failure-prone regions.
FAIR instead binds guidance to the relevant failure-prone region, confining external evidence there.
blocks.zh:
参考恢复。 基于参考的修复利用外部高质量图像来恢复从严重退化的投入中无法弥补的细节.
早期方法依靠补丁匹配和纹理转移(张等,2019年;杨等,2020年;吕等,2021年;蒋等,2021年;曹等,2022年),一般假定有校准,强调引用.
最近的推广办法放宽了这一要求: ReFIR(Guo等人,2024年)通过跨图像的注意注入检索到的特征,RASR(Yan等人,2026年)形成检索加固的参考超分辨率,Ada RefSR(Wang等人,2026年)根据当地的相关性进行适应性加权的参考特征.
然而,这些方法使用参考材料作为全面重建的首要条件,而没有明确模拟容易失败的地区。
FAIR将指导约束在相关的故障易发地区,将外部证据限制在那里.

blocks.en: 4.1 Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 结果

blocks.en:
Among reference-based methods using the same v v , FAIR reduces FID from 81.93 81.93 to 63.28 63.28 and LPIPS in from 0.0368 0.0368 to 0.0319 0.0319 (Table 1 ), indicating better perceptual quality and target-region fidelity. FAIR also achieves the highest DINO-Sim-Ref and CLIP-Sim-Ref scores, showing stronger alignment with v v alongside lower GT-based LPIPS in . It ranks first on Q-Align and TOPIQ and achieves the lowest LPIPS in in every failure tier, with the largest margin on OCR/ID
(Appendix D.3 ); WR-SR, real-world and runtime results
are in Appendix D .
Fig. 7 illustrates these differences: competing methods
either leave the region blurred or generate structures inconsistent with the reference, most visibly on the seal, where several baselines invent
an unrelated emblem. A HYPIR-to-FLUX.2-klein-9B cascade that restores first and corrects afterward also underperforms FAIR on every reported metric
(Appendix D.9 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We address the last-mile problem in generative image restoration, where
localized failures can make an otherwise plausible result unacceptable.
FAIR predicts failure-prone regions from the low-quality input, prepares
restoration guidance P = ( t , v ) P=(t,v) for their needs, and applies it through region
control R R during restoration. A 67 k k -region failure-aware dataset,
localized multimodal conditioning, and a two-stage region-aware curriculum
support this approach.
Across synthetic, reference-based, and in-the-wild settings, FAIR improves
perceptual quality, reference alignment, and local controllability. A blinded
study also favors FAIR on overall quality, target correction, and non-target
preservation. These results show the value of identifying where restoration
needs additional evidence and preparing the corresponding guidance in advance.

Detection uses merged LoRA weights and a static KV cache. Retrieval keeps the index of 4.1 4.1 M DINOv3-L/16 tile features on the GPU ( search_k = 64 \,{=}\,64 ), reranks with CLIP-B/32 (top eight), and recrops and verifies the selected candidate with SAM3 and Qwen3-VL-4B. blocks.en: LPIPS in measures perceptual distance, so we also check whether the restored regions keep the right text, identity, and content (Table 5 ). Text. Qwen3-VL-4B transcribes each text region, and we compute the character error rate (CER) against the annotated text. CER is averaged over the regions whose clean GT crop the same reader transcribes with CER ≤ 0.35 \leq 0.35 , so that illegible ground truth does not dominate; character recall, the fraction of GT characters recovered, is averaged over all annotated text regions. Identity. RetinaFace detects landmarks on each GT face crop, every method’s output is aligned with the same transform, and we report the ArcFace cosine similarity to GT. Content. For each of the 120 120 regions, Qwen3-VL-4B first identifies the GT content (object structure, text, identity, logos, or material patterns) and then checks whether the output keeps it; less sharp outputs count as matches when the content is preserved. Responses are limited to 220 220 tokens, and a response without a final verdict counts as a non-match. blocks.en: Region control. Region control specifies which object receives guidance. When similar objects fit the same description, the instruction alone cannot distinguish them. In strict-region mode, FAIR uses reference-guided restoration inside R R and reference-free restoration outside, so only the selected boy receives the plaid pattern (Fig. 9 , bottom). Image- and region-level averages change little without R R because LPIPS spatially averages feature differences, diluting changes confined to one object. Table 23 reports results with and without R R .
blocks.zh: 地区控制. 区域控制指定哪个对象接受指导. 当类似对象符合同一描述时,单指令无法区分它们. 在严格区域模式下,FAIR在R R内部使用参考制导的修复,在外部使用无参考的修复,因此只有被选中的男孩才能得到图案的图案(图9,底部). 由于LPIPS空间平均值的特征差异,缩小限制在一个物体上的变化,图像级和地区级平均值没有R的改变很小. 表23 报告的结果有的没有RR。
